blocks.title: Storytelling
blocks.text: Storytelling alfaaz, tasveeron aur jazbat se aisi kahani banata hai jo sameen ko mashghool kare, tawajjo kheenche, pecheeda khayalat aasan kare aur paigham yaad rakhne mein madad de.

School ke mubahise 'Kya plastic bags par pabandi honi chahiye?' mein samundar ke kinare ki sair ka qissa sunana jahan plastic ne samundari zindagi ko nuqsan pohanchaya daleel ko zyada qareeb aur qail karne wala banata hai. Heer Ranjha aur Sassi Punnu jaisi kahaniyan naslon se chali aa rahi hain jo mohabbat, bahaduri aur qurbani ke sabaq deti hain (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Class activity: daire mein har student mushtarak kahani mein ek jumla jorta hai. Storytelling karobar ko kaise faida deti hai (short question 6)? Is ke liye kaunsi maharat zaroori hai (MCQ 9)?
blocks.explanation: (b) jazbati rabta. Karobar kaise aur kyun shuru hua, ya kisi asal gahak ki kaise madad ki, is ki kahani logon ko brand yaad rakhne aur us par bharosa karne deti, product saadgi se samjhati aur gahakon ko himayati banati hai.

items: Storytelling: kahani aur jazbat paigham ko yaadgar aur qail karne wala banate hain.
